description: This is an HTML source file implementing a web-based database visualizer interface. It contains static HTML structure, CSS styles, and client-side JavaScript code to interact with API endpoints for listing databases, tables, and data visualization.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases from the API and populates the database list panel.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Triggers a reload of the database list and resets current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database's table list and loads its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data for a specific table from the selected database.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs HTML table from data and displays it in the container.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for each cell, handling objects and long text with expand feature.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long text or objects.
